source: fork raliclo/busybox branch develop; upstream git.busybox.net
purpose: Core userspace and /bin/sh (BR2_SYSTEM_BIN_SH_BUSYBOX). Provides /bin/tar as an applet.
status_notes: CORRECTED 2026-08-10 after reading the generated .config: the tar applet supports NO compression at all, not merely no zstd. Every CONFIG_FEATURE_SEAMLESS_* (GZ, BZ2, XZ, LZMA, Z) is off and so is FEATURE_TAR_AUTODETECT, so -z is not even a recognised option -- verified in-guest, busybox tar -czf exits non-zero with 'invalid option'. Standalone gzip/gunzip/xz/lzma applets do exist, so compressed archives can still be handled through a pipe. swift_tar is the only tar in this rootfs that compresses on its own.

purpose: Compression; consumed by libcurl and swift_tar.
status_notes: Two project fixes were needed. (1) configure hardcoded Apple libtool as AR on a Darwin host, producing an 8-byte libz.a -- fixed in the submodule. (2) The Darwin branch also sets shared_ext=.dylib and a -dynamiclib LDSHARED, so --uname=Linux must be passed or no libz.so.1 is produced at all and the Swift toolchain's clang cannot start. develop-win branches from the pre-fix commit for future Windows work.

purpose: tar.zstd support in the guest and a swift_tar link dependency.
status_notes: Added 2026-08-09. Fills the busybox zstd gap. Needed a project fix: zstd picks its shared-library flavour from UNAME_TARGET_SYSTEM, which defaults to the BUILD host, so cross-compiling from macOS produced a .dylib. Upstream declares it with ?= as the cross-compilation hook, so UNAME_TARGET_SYSTEM=Linux is the intended fix.

Added 2026-08-09. Same host-vs-target bug shape as zstd: TARGET_OS ?= $(uname) meant the target build emitted a Mach-O dylib and passed -install_name to the Linux cross gcc. Fixed with TARGET_OS=Linux.

purpose: ZIP backend for swift_tar; since 2026-08-13 also /usr/bin/bsdtar.
status_notes: Added 2026-08-09. Used instead of swift_tar's bundled static libarchive because the guest has no cmake. swift_tar's own libarchive submodule is not checked out. Built --without-xml2 since 2026-08-10, which drops xar support only -- libarchive uses libxml2 in exactly two files, archive_{read_support,write_set}_format_xar.c. BR2_PACKAGE_LIBARCHIVE_BSDTAR added 2026-08-13 so the guest has the same tar implementation as macOS: guest bsdtar 3.8.8 vs macOS bsdtar 3.5.3 / libarchive 3.7.4. It costs only the 70 KiB driver -- libarchive.so was already present for swift_tar -- and the rootfs went 62.1 to 62.2 MiB. Interop is verified by linux_test/test_tar_compat.zsh, which also pinned down the two ways the two sides disagree: macOS defaults write AppleDouble ._* companions, and the guest needs LANG=C.UTF-8 or bsdtar exits 1 on any non-ASCII pathname.

Added 2026-08-09. Found by enumerating DT_NEEDED across every binary in the toolchain: swift-frontend -- the compiler proper -- links libuuid.so.1. Only BR2_PACKAGE_UTIL_LINUX_LIBUUID is selected, not the binaries.

purpose: Terminal handling; required by zsh and the Swift toolchain.
status_notes: Built without --with-termlib and buildroot offers no option to enable it, so libtinfo.so.6 is never produced -- yet the Swift toolchain lists it in DT_NEEDED. The rootfs overlay adds a libtinfo.so.6 -> libncurses.so.6 symlink; the terminfo symbols live inside libncurses in this configuration, so the alias resolves correctly.

purpose: 讓 dev 執行韌體 staging（/usr/sbin/fw-stage）與關機/重開機，其餘一律拒絕。
status_notes: Added 2026-08-11 with the user-space phase. Built --without-pam (BR2_PACKAGE_LINUX_PAM is off), so it reads /etc/shadow directly. Its own SUDO_PERMISSIONS sets /usr/bin/sudo 4755 and SUDO_USERS creates the sudo group -- but BOTH are applied by makedevs/chown under fakeroot, which does not run on macOS, so fix_image_ownership.sh has to reapply them or sudo refuses to start with 'must be owned by uid 0 and have the setuid bit set'. The policy lives in an overlay file /etc/sudoers.d/firmware (0440, enforced by rootfs_post_build.sh); the overlay survives because sudo.mk's SUDO_REMOVE_DIST_EXAMPLES uses rmdir --ignore-fail-on-non-empty. Whitelist is by absolute path, never a role: fw-stage plus poweroff/reboot/halt. poweroff is not a convenience -- a firmware update is not complete until reboot, and an unclean kill is how this project corrupted its workspace ext4 once.

Added 2026-08-11, pulled in automatically (BR2_PACKAGE_SUDO selects it on glibc, which no longer ships libcrypt). Needed a project fix to build its HOST counterpart on macOS: configure does not use AC_C_BIGENDIAN but hunts for macro combinations in <endian.h>/<sys/endian.h>/<sys/param.h>, none of which macOS has. See FAQ 成因一.

KNOWN GAP as of 2026-08-11. BR2_PACKAGE_GLIBC_UTILS=y is set and /etc/init.d/S41ldconfig exists, but /sbin/ldconfig is NOT in the image: glibc was already built, and changing an option does not force a package to reinstall (the same trap that made the ICU removal appear to work). S41ldconfig tests [ -x /sbin/ldconfig ] and exits 0, so this fails safe rather than noisily. It is also NOT load-bearing: swiftc emits a RUNPATH pointing at the versioned toolchain directory, so Swift binaries resolve their libraries without any cache or LD_LIBRARY_PATH. Fix when convenient by removing output/build/glibc-* and rebuilding.
